text: Admission rejected on reproducible evidence. Installed effectagram 0.0.0.9000 and shard 0.2.0 passed total/coherent numerical parity plus normal and injected-failure cleanup, but both cold modes failed the predeclared 1.1x speed gate (response 0.26x; relation 0.27x vs sequential). Reused modes were 0.54x and 0.79x. Version 0.1 remains sequential-only with no shard dependency; retain descriptor/task boundaries for future heavier-work or genuinely reused-scope re-benchmarking.
